justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Home modifications reduce fall risk and extend independent living; CAPS certification-specific outcome studies absent.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 2-3 day NAHB course; moderate cost; accessible to OT and allied health professionals.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable in home health, geriatric OT, and community practice settings; limited in acute or outpatient clinical.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Home modification consulting is primarily self-pay; CAPS enables assessments reimbursable under some long-term care and home health policies.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Growing demand in home modification consulting and aging-in-place services; moderate clinical employer demand.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Aging in place is strongly preferred; successful modification is highly valued by older adults.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Adult children frequently pay cash for home assessments and aging-in-place consulting.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Consulting model supports flat-fee pricing well above PT visit rates.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Rare among PT/OTs; pairs the clinician with builder/designer credibility.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Highly scalable consulting + contractor partnership model.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Demographic tailwind — boomer aging-in-place demand is large and growing.
justifications.business.efficiency: Short NAHB course, inexpensive — very efficient credential to add.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Industry/builder credential, not academically weighted in PT/OT hiring.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Minimal peer-reviewed scholarship tied to CAPS specifically.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Some relevance to home health and geriatric environmental modification content.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Home modification has decent evidence (e.g., Stark/CAPABLE), but CAPS itself isn't the evidence carrier.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Essentially never listed in faculty postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Cheap and fast if a program does want geriatric environmental content.
